anchor.surface_text: U. P. Electricity Supply Co. Ltd. Ors. v. Their Workmen  1  has decided two questions of law. The first was in regard to the applicability of the Full Bench formula to the employees claim for bonus against their employers carrying on the business of the supply of electricity, and the second was in regard to the extent of the statutory depreciation allowed by the Full Bench formula. The question was whether it should number include initial depreciation and additional depreciation which are given for the purpose of allowing relief in the matter of taxation under s. 10 2   vi-b  of the Income-tax Act.
